name: Reverse Curve
spec: yellow diamond with a black S-shaped arrow bending right then left
meaning: Two curves ahead in opposite directions.

snippets.back: A Reverse Curve sign warns of a curve followed by one in the opposite direction; left-first and right-first versions exist.
For reverse curves, sharp turns and gradual curves, reduce speed, stay right and avoid passing. For a winding road, travel slowly and cautiously without passing.
